intended_object: No mathematical object. The docstring calls it a "checked nominal proof certificate" named upstream `nb069_alpha_dummy_015`. In fact it is a dummy variable used for alpha-renaming in machine-generated proof scripts.
explanation: The body is `freshVar (Class.cv nb069AlphaDummy007).fv 1`. It picks a variable that is fresh with respect to the free variables of an earlier dummy class term, which is the kind of name needed for capture-avoiding substitution in an internal syntactic encoding of set theory (NF). It is an auxiliary step inside an auto-generated certificate chain, with an internal implementation name and no counterpart in the literature. So it is a technical device, not a mathematical definition, and there is nothing to compare against Mathlib.
